items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: But they respected Chicago because they would sit there and listen and every -- ape and everything, because you had Louis Armstrong, Earl Hines and you had all kinds of great musicians.

ctx.x: Did your sister know Lil in Memphis?

Yeah, that's what I'm saying, in Memphis -- they went to school in -- elementary school together. All the way through school, and when I come here, then I stayed with them for awhile. We stayed with Lil and Louis. They had just gotten married. They got married in '24.
